usedFor: Outscraper finishes scraping jobs and Airtable keeps the results, with “Task Finished” triggering “Create Record” for each one.

bestTemplate.name: “Task Finished” in Outscraper, then “Create Record” in Airtable
bestTemplate.why: Each finished task adds a row to your base, so results sit where the team already works.

watchOut: “Task Finished” in Outscraper is polling, so a finished job reaches Airtable after the next scheduled check.
